WALL BUILD-UPS (mm) - boards are 2 x 13 Soundchek + damping
Dividing wall 242: 26 board | 70 stud + Rockwool | 50 air gap | 70 stud + Rockwool | 26 board. Studio
frame is freestanding and carries the ceiling; bedroom frame is fixed to trusses and slab. Bedroom face
Window-wall and back-wall leaves 121: 25 air gap | 70 stud + Rockwool | 26 board. Existing walls and
plaster left on. Gap must clear skirting, architraves and plaster blobs (builder to check). Frames stand
on the slab on a resilient strip; every edge sealed.
Existing hallway wall removed between the wardrobe end wall and the ensuite wall (added after the house
was built, so not structural: Brendan, 18 Nov 2026). Replaced by the relocated wall: 26 board | 70 stud
+ Rockwool | 50 air gap | 70 stud + Rockwool | 26 board | 21 slat panelling = 263, a new freestanding
double stud like the dividing wall.
Studio face moves out 300 (2761 to 3061); living-room face is at 3324, which is 230 past the fascia /
WIR face (3094), 250 past v4 (3074) and 370 short of the wardrobe kitchen face (3694). Fascia, 2 living-
room downlights and the pillar sit over or inside the new wall.
Window 1 plug (removable): board / Rockwool / board in the reveal, about 40 deep, compression
seals, 10 to 20 off the glass. Sliders locked and sealed. Check reveal depth on site; it can stand
Double door, leaf 820 assumed: inner solid-core leaf swings in, outer hidden slat-clad leaf (2260
high, up to the fascia line) swings out. Hinges on the ensuite side, hinge jamb 100 off the back-
wall leaf. Door sits in the relocated wall, so the outer leaf swings from 250 further into the
living room than v4; re-check against the WIR switch and the walkway.
112 The Gateway, Lilydale - Studio Build - studio (back) + bedroom (door end)
Scale 1:25 at A3. Dimensions in mm. Drawn over BASE PLAN v2 geometry (112 walls, unchanged).
v5 = v4 with the hallway wall moved out 300 (OPTION B). Concept only. Not for construction.
Living-room face at x 3324: 230 past the fascia / WIR face (3094), 250 past v4 (3074), 370 behind the wardrobe face (3694).
Existing hallway wall removed; fascia, 2 living-room downlights and the recess pillar sit over or inside the new wall.
Ceiling: plaster stripped, blown-in insulation replaced with Rockwool. New independent joists
(about 140 x 45, size by builder) at 450, run back wall to dividing wall and bear on the
freestanding studio frames only. 25 clear of the truss chords. Two layers Soundchek with damping
compound, edges sealed, Rockwool over. Finished ceiling about 2230 to 2250.
Fan well: 340 square lined box between two joists and two trusses (bay TBC in roof space), canopy
at 2420 so blades sit at 2100 (fan drop 320). Two layers of board, own brace on the new joists,
Services: P3 moved onto the new back wall; P2 sits in the dividing-wall zone and is relocated; H2
blocked off and sealed above the new ceiling; DL2 removed; new studio switch. Fire-rated acoustic
putty pads on all boxes. Electrician does all fixed wiring.
Kit on a decoupled riser on the slab. Kit footprint is indicative only.
Ventilation: v4 positions kept as PLACEHOLDERS for a like-for-like comparison. Your 16 Nov choice
(DIY inline fans + sound mazes through the roof, no ERV) is not drawn yet.
End cap: the wall now stands past the WIR corner (3094), so a closed end (70 stud, 26 board, 21
panelling) is drawn. Junction with the 850 WIR diagonal not resolved.
